items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: George Wein called me to put together a Chick Webb band for the Carnegie Hall with Ella.

ctx.x: : I was going up to the employees' entrance to the Garden for a hockey game, and you had gone in the other.
So now -- then so 1976 I went to Nice. In fact, in 1973 -- George Wein called me to put together a Chick Webb band for the Carnegie Hall with Ella.
